patthana17.4:1.1: akusalaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na akusalo na saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi. kusalaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na asaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
